title: Senate Floor Debate
subtitle: S.890 — Tax Relief for Working Families Act

metadata.laymanSummary: The Senate passed a bill expanding the Child Tax Credit and Earned Income Tax Credit while restoring some business tax provisions from the 2017 tax law.

data.billTitle: Tax Relief for Working Families Act — Expanding the Child Tax Credit and restoring business R&D expensing

speakers.name: Sen. Tim Scott
speakers.title: R-SC · Senate Finance
speakers.quote: I grew up in poverty. The Earned Income Tax Credit changed my family's trajectory. This bill makes the EITC and the Child Tax Credit more accessible, keeps more money in the hands of working Americans, and restores business tax incentives that drive the innovation keeping us competitive with China.

speakers.name: Sen. Bernie Sanders
speakers.title: I-VT · Senate HELP
speakers.quote: The Child Tax Credit expansion in this bill will lift an estimated 3.5 million children out of poverty. That is not a left-wing idea or a right-wing idea — that is a moral obligation. I support this bill and urge every senator to do the same.

speakers.name: Sen. Rand Paul
speakers.title: R-KY · Senate
speakers.quote: Any tax bill that does not come with matching spending cuts simply borrows money from our children and calls it relief. We are passing the cost of today's generosity to the next generation. That is not relief — it is a debt sentence.

data.title: What This Vote Means
data.text: S.890 passed 56-43 with bipartisan support. The bill expands the Child Tax Credit to $2,100 per child, increases the Earned Income Tax Credit for childless workers, and restores 100% first-year expensing for R&D investments that expired in 2022. CBO estimates the package costs $78 billion over ten years, offset partially by closing several corporate loopholes.
